# scc_hold_compliance_rule (Data Source)

Look up an existing HoldComplianceRule object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `content_date_from` (String) Maps to the -ContentDateFrom parameter.
- `content_date_to` (String) Maps to the -ContentDateTo parameter.
- `content_match_query` (String) Maps to the -ContentMatchQuery parameter.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Disabled parameter.
- `hold_content` (String) Maps to the -HoldContent parameter.
- `hold_duration_display_hint` (String) Maps to the -HoldDurationDisplayHint parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
